column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT a.loan_cycle AS loanCycle, a.active_loans AS activeLoans, COALESCE((SELECT l.principal_amount FROM m_loan l WHERE l.client_id=${clientId} AND l.loan_status_id=300 AND l.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.disbursedon_date DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS lastLoanAmount, d.active_savings AS activeSavings, d.total_savings AS totalSavings FROM m_client c JOIN m_office o ON o.id=c.office_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(l.loan_counter), 0) AS loan_cycle, COUNT(l.id) AS active_loans FROM m_loan l WHERE l.loan_status_id=300 AND l.client_id=${clientId}) a CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS active_savings, COALESCE(SUM(s.account_balance_derived), 0) AS total_savings FROM m_savings_account s WHERE s.status_enum=300 AND s.client_id=${clientId}) d WHERE c.id=${clientId} AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%')
